text:
Yara N.: Quick feedback from the console review: when the compact table sits under the sticky header the toast uses the same spacing token as the card and ends up hugging the header. Also noticed the modal action shadow is stronger than other components. Screenshot: https://redwood-assets.example/edge-gap-toast.png :eyes:

Diego M.: Repro. The spacing token `--space-2` is being reused for toast offset; we should introduce a semantic token like `--toast-offset-top` so teams can opt in. Shadow feels like `--shadow-action-lg` but should be `--shadow-action-sm` to match footprint.

ux-bot: Suggested token list: [`--toast-offset-top`, `--toast-z`, `--shadow-action-sm`, `--button-focus-dark: 2px`]. Accessibility reminder: toasts need explicit announcement text, avoid bare "Saved".

Sam K.: Implementation plan: portal to root, use `position: fixed` with `top: var(--toast-offset-top)`, default `--toast-offset-top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-3))`. Lower toast z-index to 1100 so dropdowns and menus overlay correctly. Will add `pointer-events: none` on the wrapper.

Priya V.: Copy suggestion: prefer "Settings saved" or fallback "Changes saved". Also we should alias legacy token `--legacy-toast-inline` for teams that need previous behavior.

Yara N.: Can we also document the new token names in the component docs and add a migration note? Small teams will appreciate the alias.

Diego M.: I'll open PR in `ui/patches` with tokens, portal change, and a visual snapshot for dense table + header. ETA today.
